newsitem.title: USA: Box natgas find boosts production 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Box natgas find boosts production 20 pct.

text.p: Box Energy Corp said on Thursday its natural gas discovery in offshore Louisiana boosted the company's total natgas production volume by 20 percent.
The Main Pass 262 SS 1 well, formerly called Well 3, is producing 16.6 million cubic feet per day, increasing total production for the block to 21.8 million cubic feet per day.
Main Pass Block 262 is owned by Box, Cairn Energy USA and CXY Energy Offshore Inc, each with 33 percent. CXY, a wholly owned subsidiary of Canadian Occidental Petroleum Ltd, is the operator.
